assessment.notes: One UDP_SEGMENT send entered the egress hook as a four-segment GSO skb. A UDP_GRO receiver caused ingress to expose the matching four-segment aggregate. The verifier-bounded eBPF loop emitted one hash per logical segment in each direction; all four unique hashes matched exactly. The implementation caps expansion at 64 logical segments and increments the explicit BPF dropped counter when an skb exceeds that cap.
